UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" && wget -q https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -O dotnet-install.sh && chmod +x ./dotnet-install.sh && ./dotnet-install.sh --version latest --install-dir \"{{$FullRootDir}}dotnet\" && ./dotnet-install.sh --runtime aspnetcore --channel 10.0 --install-dir \"{{$FullRootDir}}dotnet\" && rm -f ./dotnet-install.sh"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullRootDir}}'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.ps1' -OutFile 'dotnet-install.ps1'; & .\dotnet-install.ps1 -Version latest -InstallDir '{{$FullRootDir}}dotnet'; & .\dotnet-install.ps1 -Runtime aspnetcore -Channel 10.0 -InstallDir '{{$FullRootDir}}dotnet'; Remove-Item -Force 'dotnet-install.ps1' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullRootDir}}7-Zip'; if (Test-Path '7z.exe') { exit 0 }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-x64.exe' -OutFile '7z-installer.exe'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7zr.exe' -OutFile '7zr.exe'; & .\7zr.exe x -y -aoa .\7z-installer.exe *> $null; Remove-Item -Force .\7z-installer.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"

-c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}7-Zip\" && if [[ -x 7zzs || -x 7zz ]]; then exit 0; fi; wget -qO 7z.tar.xz https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-linux-x64.tar.xz && tar -xf 7z.tar.xz >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f 7z.tar.xz"
-c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}server\" && if [[ -d SPT.bak ]]; then rm -rf SPT.bak; fi; if [[ -d SPT ]]; then cp -rf SPT SPT.bak; fi"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullRootDir}}server'; $ReleasePage=(Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/sp-tarkov/build/releases/latest').Content; $DownloadURL=[regex]::Match($ReleasePage,'https://spt-releases\.modd\.in/[^\"'' ]+\.7z').Value; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DownloadURL)) { Write-Error 'Could not find SPT 7z download URL'; exit 1 }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $DownloadURL -OutFile 'SPT.7z'; & '..\7-Zip\7z.exe' x -y -aoa 'SPT.7z' | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'SPT.7z' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"

-c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}server\" && DownloadURL=$(wget -qO- https://github.com/sp-tarkov/build/releases/latest | grep -Eo 'https://spt-releases\.modd\.in/[^\"[:space:]]+\.7z' | head -n1); if [[ -z \"$DownloadURL\" ]]; then echo 'Could not find SPT 7z download URL'; exit 1; fi; wget -qO SPT.7z \"$DownloadURL\" && ../7-Zip/7zzs x -y -aoa SPT.7z >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f SPT.7z && chmod +x SPT/SPT.Server.Linux"
